audit.summary: All assets pass audit. Logos (SVG + PNG) are hosted on official celio.com CDN and correctly represent the celio* brand. The 'activewear-logo-min.png' is a faint raster variant suitable for accessible fallback. Product images (6 packshots) are high-quality, official celio.com e-commerce assets depicting the McLaren Racing capsule jacket in full detail, studio, and lifestyle contexts. Colors (#FF8000 papaya orange, #000000 black, #FFFFFF white) and McLaren F1 racing motifs (checkered flag, MCL39, 'Born for the track', 'Formula 1 Team') are consistently applied. All assets are readable at small banner sizes and suitable for HTML5 display ad generation.
